== Notes ==
* Can be traded to a [[Voidwatch Officer]] to obtain a [[Voidstone]].
** When trading Voiddust, it can not, and will not, be turned into {{color|lightning|stock}}; instead, it will be turned into more Voidstone key items. You can trade multiple Voiddust at a time.
* Can be found in Treasure Caskets in certain [[Grounds of Valor]] zones.
